data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Aaida means ‘guide, helper’ or ‘she who leads’. This name is derived from the Arabic root ‘a’d’, meaning to guide or to lead. In Islamic history, Aaida is the name of several notable figures, including a wife of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and a companion of the fourth caliph, Ali ibn Abi Talib (ra).
